description: This file defines the 'Article' controller class for the Opencart CMS module. It handles displaying a specific article, managing breadcrumbs, loading models and views, and preparing data for rendering.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying an individual CMS article, including setting page metadata, breadcrumbs, images, and comments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for handling the display of an article page. Loads language, models, retrieves article and topic info, builds breadcrumbs, prepares view data, and renders the article view.
